svg.title: Whole humanoid: worst hinge axis error
svg.desc: Four small-multiple panels, one per body size, of worst hinge axis error in radians for Jolt and PhysX articulation over six scenes at 120 and 200 Hz. PhysX values are 0.00098 to 0.0013 rad; Jolt reaches 1.23 rad. Lower is better (axis error in rad). Green = the lower bar of each row (no percent of best: log-scale errors). Best result in each comparison group drawn green.

svg.text: 48 files (6 scenes x 4 sizes x 2 rates), run 1 of 2 per backend; labelled values are above the flag level (0.1). Of 48 Jolt cells 29 are
PhysX range 0.00098 to 0.0013; Jolt range 0.0074 to 1.2. The scenes use library-default solver iterations; no machine-load dependence
(timings unused). Thresholds (0.01 m, 0.1 m, 0.1 rad) are harness choices, not standards.
One skeleton, boxes only, float32, CPU, one machine; Jolt 5.7.0 tag v5.7.0; PhysX 5.13.0 built from a branch head, not a tag.
